title: Jersey Royal Potato Gratin
description: A creamy, flavorful potato gratin perfect for a cozy evening. This vegetarian dish is sure to please even the pickiest eaters.
instructions: Peel the potatoes and slice them into 1/8-inch thick rounds.
In a large saucepan, combine the sliced potatoes and enough cold water to cover them. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and set them aside to dry.
In a separate saucepan, melt the floral butter over medium heat. Add the shredded aerated cheese and stir until it's well combined and melted.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, create a layer of potatoes. Top with a layer of the cheese mixture, followed by a sprinkle of Ukrainian bread crumbs.
Repeat this process two more times, ending with a layer of potatoes on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
